description:
Project Overview

Lancaster University is seeking candidates to join the world’s largest AI security group. These PhD positions focus on protecting AI models and agents from rapidly emerging cyber threats. Topics include prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaking, model backdoors, agent hijacking, and more. The positions are highly sought after and provide the skill and training necessary to become a researcher specializing in AI security.

Research Areas

Topics of interest include:

  • Discover new types of cyber attacks / security vulnerabilities in AI and agents.
  • Create defence systems and countermeasures against AI agent cyber attacks.
  • Design run-time detection systems for prompt injection and jailbreaking.
  • Explore different cyber attack modalities (i.e. malicious instructions in images/audio).
  • Build and develop LLM guardrails and firewalls.
  • Investigate hidden security characteristics within neural networks.
  • Identify ShadowAI – malicious AI agents hidden within an organization.
  • Uncover backdoor attacks and model hijacking within ML artefacts.

What We Offer

  • A 3.5-year fully funded PhD studentship at UK home fee levels (including both tuition and stipend).
  • Access to a large-scale GPU data centre entirely dedicated to our research lab.
  • Comprehensive training in AI agent technology and cyber security techniques.
  • Internship and employment opportunities at Mindgard, an award-winning AI security company.
  • Opportunity to travel to conferences internationally to present your research.

About You

  • A good background in Computer Science, ideally a BSc in Computer Science (or equivalent) with a 2:1 classification and above.
  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Distributed Systems, or a combination.
  • Highly motivated, capable of working independently and as part of a team.
  • Good communication, technical knowledge, and writing skills.

Funding

  • 3.5-year fully funded studentship at UK home fee levels (tuition and stipend).

Eligibility

  • This position is only available for UK home students.

Application

These positions are available now; candidates are strongly recommended to apply as early as possible. For informal enquiries, contact Professor Peter Garraghan. To apply, visit the school PhD opportunities page.

Official Link

https://www.lancaster.ac.uk/scc/study/phd/phd-opportunities/
